description: Audit the prerequisites of highlighted target nodes, their statements/proofs, and explicitly recorded terminology in prose. Complete sections supply context; unrelated results in those sections do not become new targets. Sets and undergraduate algebra remain assumed. GRR has no final proof in this edition.

006N.001L: Opposite categories used for category-valued presheaves.

01DZ.0076: Sheaves of modules and their morphisms.
01DZ.007S: Exactness of sheaves is checked on stalks.

01M7.00JL: Graded modules and the shift M(n) are defined in prose.
01M7.00JM: The topological space Proj and homogeneous localization precede its scheme structure.

0A23.04MS: Dimension in the definition of a curve.
0A23.01OJ: Integral schemes in the definition of a variety.

0BY7.01OU: Noetherian schemes in the genus definition.
0BY7.01W1: Proper schemes in the genus definition.

02UM.01C5: Finite locally free sheaves and rank are introduced in prose.
02UM.02UK: Chern roots are introduced in prose after the splitting principle.

02UN.02UK: The Todd class is defined in prose using Chern roots.

02UO.01CM: The internal Hom used to define the relative tangent sheaf.
02UO.01C5: Finite locally free sheaves in the hypotheses.
02UO.01T0: Locally finite type morphisms in the hypotheses.

excluded_references.sets-section-sets-everything: Set-theoretic foundations are assumed by the reader.
excluded_references.fields-example-quotient-field: Fields of fractions are part of assumed undergraduate algebra.
excluded_references.pic-definition-genus: Historical comparison with an earlier special-case definition; the curve genus is defined in full in the selected section.
